name: 37167 · Smyrna, TN
findings: ZIP 37167 (Smyrna) has 123 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (34% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37167 (Smyrna) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 37167 (Smyrna) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).

observations.text: 12 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
